SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.noSupabase: Supabase is not configured. Add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to .env — see docs/provisioning.md.
SignIn.subtitle: Continue with Google, or we'll email you a magic link — no password to remember.

Sell.noSupabase: Configure Supabase to sell bouquets. Run supabase start, copy keys to .env, then supabase db reset for seed listings.
Sell.photosSubtitle: Snap the bouquet in good light. AI does the rest — naming, freshness and a quality check.
Sell.photosTip: Daylight near a window works best. Fill the frame with the bouquet and keep the background simple.
Sell.overallConfidence: Overall confidence {pct}% — you can rename anything next.
Sell.detailsPrefill: Name and freshness are prefilled. Just set your price.
Sell.detailsAiFail: AI analysis didn't work this time — fill in the details yourself.
Sell.detailsManual: Fill in the details — it takes 30 seconds.
Sell.title: Title
Sell.priceHint: You decide the price. AI never suggests or sets it.

Sell.locationRequired: Location is required so buyers can find your bouquet nearby.
Sell.pinHint: Drag the pin to your pickup spot. Buyers see your neighborhood, distance, and an approximate area — never your exact address.
Sell.areaHint: Buyers see your neighborhood & distance — never your exact address. You can edit the label above.
Sell.contactHint: At least one channel is required.
Sell.buyersSee: Buyers see exactly this card in the feed.
